title.zh: 将拉乌尼翁第二区工程办公室由拉乌尼翁Naguilian迁至拉乌尼翁Agoo，为此修订第9033号共和国法
title.en: An Act Transferring the Location of the La Union Second District Engineering Office From Naguilian, La Union to Agoo, La Union, Amending for This Purpose Republic Act No. 9033
title.orig: An Act Transferring the Location of the La Union Second District Engineering Office From Naguilian, La Union to Agoo, La Union, Amending for This Purpose Republic Act No. 9033

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 9033 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SECTION 1. The Sub-District Engineering-Office located in Naguilian. La Union, under the supervision of the Department of Public Works and Highways, shall be converted into a regular engineering district to be known as the La Union Second Engineering District and is hereby relocated to Agoo, La Union."
Repealing Clause. – All laws or parts of any law, orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.
Effectivity Clause. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
